test_BaseVideoDatasetFactory_basic: test the BaseVideoDatasetFactory by creating a dataset from TFRecord shards with default configuration
test_BaseVideoDatasetFactory_configure: test the factory configure method with sample offset, multiply, and reduce_max options
test_BaseVideoDatasetFactory_filter: test adding filter functions at different pipeline phases like PARSE, SAMPLE, DECODE, or PREPROCESS
test_BaseVideoDatasetFactory_keep_key: test the make_dataset keep_key option to preserve feature keys in the output dataset
test_BaseVideoDatasetFactory_ignore_erro: test the ignore_processing_errors option to skip examples that fail during decoding
